svg.text: On a miss, read the indexed row, then fill the cache; expired rows return 410 Gone, otherwise 302 to the long URL

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Scale: 1B URLs, 100M DAU × 5 redirects ≈ 5.8k/s average, ~600k/s with a 100x spike allowance; ~100k new URLs/day ≈ 1 write/s

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Storage: ~500 B/row × 1B = ~500 GB, fits one modern SSD-backed Postgres (replicate for HA; shard only if needed)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Multi-region: give each region a disjoint counter range. A few skipped counter values after a Redis failover are fine: only uniqueness matters
